items.exampleEn: The singer thanked her supporters after the show.
items.exampleZh: 那位歌手在演出後感謝她的支持者。

items.exampleEn: My dog accompanies me on my morning walk.
items.exampleZh: 我的狗陪我一起晨間散步。

items.exampleEn: The shop's sales made a quick recovery after the new road opened.
items.exampleZh: 新路開通後，店裡的營業額很快就恢復了。

items.exampleEn: The old house resisted the strong wind.
items.exampleZh: 那棟老房子抵擋住了強風。

items.exampleEn: Can you assist me with these heavy boxes?
items.exampleZh: 你可以協助我搬這些重箱子嗎？

items.exampleEn: Birds construct their homes from small sticks.
We installed new lights in the kitchen.
The cook's careful preparation made the meal special.
items.exampleZh: 廚師細心的準備讓這頓飯很特別。

items.sentenceEn: Most supporters stayed until the end of the game.
items.sentenceZh: 大部分的支持者都待到比賽結束。

items.audioEn: A worker will come on Tuesday to install the new air conditioning.
items.audioZh: 星期二會有工人來安裝新的冷氣。
items.questionZh: 星期二會有人來做什麼？
options: Check all the windows in the house.
Put in a new cooling system.

items.sentenceEn: The children resisted going to bed early.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們不肯早點上床睡覺。

items.sentenceEn: This tall building was constructed in 1990.

items.stemEn: Children under twelve must be ____ by an adult.
items.stemZh: 十二歲以下的兒童必須由大人陪同。

items.stemEn: Good ____ is the key to passing any exam.
items.stemZh: 充分的準備是通過任何考試的關鍵。

items.passageEn: My uncle is a big supporter of our local football team, which has a good reputation. Last year, the city started to construct a new stadium, and he helped install the seats as a volunteer. The preparation took three months. During this time, our team lost several games, but its recovery was quick. On the opening day, I accompanied him to the first game. He tried to resist buying a new team shirt, but in the end he bought one. During the game, a staff member at the stadium assisted a woman with a baby to find her seat.
items.passageZh: 我叔叔是我們本地足球隊的忠實支持者，這支球隊名聲很好。去年，市政府開始建造新體育場，他以志工身分幫忙安裝座位。準備工作花了三個月。這段期間球隊輸了好幾場比賽，不過很快就恢復了水準。開幕那天，我陪他去看第一場比賽。他試著忍住不買新球衣，結果最後還是買了一件。比賽中，體育場的一位工作人員協助一位帶著寶寶的女士找到座位。

questions.questionZh: 叔叔當志工時做了什麼？
叔叔最後忍不住做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 一位老師協助學生完成實驗。
referenceEn: A teacher assisted the students with the experiment.
A teacher assisted the students in doing the experiment.
rubricZh: assist 表示「協助」，例如 assist someone with… 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.promptZh: 這場會議需要很多準備。
referenceEn: This meeting needs a lot of preparation.
A lot of preparation is needed for this meeting.
rubricZh: 用 preparation 表示「準備」（例如 a lot of preparation）
